ideas.title: Resume and LinkedIn polish service
ideas.one_liner: Job seekers pay a fixed fee for a rewritten resume and matching LinkedIn headline section.

cost_breakdown.item: Job-board ad or group post boosts

steps: Rewrite your own resume as the sample
Rewrite one free for a friend
Collect 25 before/after samples
Post the offer in local job groups
Offer $79 resume plus LinkedIn rewrite, 3-day turnaround
Send a fill-in worksheet first
Ask each client for a referral at handover
first_customers: Google Maps 4-star shops with unanswered reviews
pitfalls: Never invent experience for clients
Tailor keywords to the real job ad
Deliver editable files, not just PDFs
